description: This file contains an extension to the OnboardingView class, providing various user interaction methods related to onboarding, gateway selection, settings navigation, and clipboard operations in a macOS application using SwiftUI and AppKit.

methods.name: selectLocalGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to local, clears preferred gateway ID, disables advanced connection, and resets gateway preferences.

methods.name: selectUnconfiguredGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to unconfigured, cancels any ongoing onboarding wizard tasks, clears preferred gateway ID, and resets gateway preferences.

methods.name: selectRemoteGateway
methods.description: Sets the preferred gateway ID, updates gateway preferences, applies remote selection support, sets connection mode to remote, and updates shared gateway ID.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Requests to open a specific settings tab and posts a notification to open the corresponding UI tab.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Navigates back in the onboarding wizard with animation.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next onboarding page or finishes onboarding if at the end.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks onboarding as seen in user defaults and closes the onboarding controller.

methods.name: copyToPasteboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to the clipboard, flags UI as copied, and resets the flag after a delay.
